pins.anchor: focus (mouse click or Tab) is **a border colour change, one 1px stroke**
pins.invariant: Focus is one 1px stroke that changes colour: no ring larger than 1px, no translucent box-shadow halo, no thick outline.
Every interactive control has a non-empty accessible name; an icon-only control carries an aria-label.
A control is either wired, hidden, or disabled; a visible enabled control is reachable and named.

pins.anchor: These five words are **enforced by machine**
pins.invariant: No banned phrase of vocabulary.md §4 appears in on-screen text.
A raw key, an unfilled {placeholder} or an interpolation artefact must never reach the screen.

pins.anchor: Every language in Settings › Language must be complete
pins.invariant: On a non-English interface language the screen carries no untranslated English string.
The catalogue is the only list of switches and decides each default; a locked switch ignores the door.

pins.anchor: the ids that are off ride on `<html data-tracy-hide="id id …">`
pins.invariant: An id answered as hidden by /api/ui rides on <html data-tracy-hide>; a door failure keeps the defaults.

pins.anchor: Show/hide of a customer-page piece that `/ops` › User Interface can switch goes through the switch
pins.invariant: A piece with a switch is hidden only through the switch: some product code reads that switch id.
No horizontal overflow at 390 px; no console errors or failed requests; every control reachable.
